therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: adrenergic receptors / carbonic anhydrase / GABA receptors
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: sympathomimetic appetite suppression and GABAergic modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in HbA1c from baseline to week 72

results.effect_size: HbA1c change: -0.5% (16-week population), -1.4% (72-week population); Weight change: -5.7% (16-week), -10.1% (72-week)
biomarker_changes: Body weight decreased by 5.7% in 16-week population
Body weight decreased by 10.1% in 72-week population
safety_signals: 1 case of coronary artery disease (serious adverse event) in 16-week population (1/44)

context.investigator_commentary: Limited regulatory value to uncontrolled trials. No safety/efficacy concerns.
